question: Does each static evaluator order the nine published files like the owner-reported scores?

HIDE-RECOVER-v3.0.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (static diagnostic) vs OWNER-REPORT leaderboard scores

SGMC-CAL-v3.0.label: HOLDOUT-DTI (static diagnostic) vs OWNER-REPORT leaderboard scores

verdict: HIDE-RECOVER ranks them in the OPPOSITE order (rho < 0). SGMC-CAL ranks them in the same order, but that agreement is not yet trustworthy: it is circular for files that use the SGMC raster as an input, and n = 9 with two dot-identical sites. Neither evaluator is cleared as the canonical proxy (IR-45-EVAL-02).
caveats: GEMSDOE25 and GEMSDOE30 are dot-identical, so they contribute tied values
SGMC-CAL truth = off-catalogue SGMC traces; any generator that reads that raster as a feature is in-sample (IR-20261029-03)
